Omit sensitive file paths, file contents, credentials and personal information.
The app is a scaffold; scanning and cleanup remain future work. Check
[product direction](https://github.com/sajjad-fatehi/reclaim/blob/dev/docs/product.md) before proposing scope.

## Problem

Who encounters this problem, and when?

## Proposed outcome

What should become possible? What alternatives have you considered?

## Safety and evidence

For storage-related work, describe permission, ownership, data-loss or recovery
concerns. Use synthetic examples; folder size alone does not prove recoverable space.
